hooks.command:
python -c "
import json, subprocess, os, sys
d = json.load(sys.stdin)
f = d.get('tool_input', {}).get('file_path', '')
if f.endswith('.js') and os.path.exists(f):
    r = subprocess.run(['node', '-c', f], capture_output=True, text=True)
    if r.returncode != 0:
        lines = (r.stderr or r.stdout).strip().splitlines()
        useful = [l for l in lines if not l.strip().startswith('at ')]
        msg = '\n'.join(useful[:5])
        print(json.dumps({'systemMessage': f'\u26a0\ufe0f JS SYNTAX ERROR in {os.path.basename(f)}:\n{msg}'}), flush=True)
"
